body.title: CG_AUTO_V32_* session-scoped only — never Doppler or cursor-wsl.env
body.summary: Auto v3.2 work package and material flags must be inline shell exports for preflight/closeout only. Doppler carries app secrets; CG_AUTO_V32_* in Doppler or ~/.config/capital-glass/cursor-wsl.env causes contamination or false audit paths.
alternateQuestions: How to verify Auto v3.2 env is not contaminated on Doppler estate?
